sections.description: Complete security audit, site hardening checklist, and vulnerability scanner for WordPress. One-click safe hardening, login protection, and client reports.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • 56 security audit and hardening checklist tasks.
  • Multi-protocol TLS probe and certificate depth analysis.
  • Strict file permissions audit and RFC 9116 security.txt generator.
  • Patchstack vulnerability database intelligence.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the site-checkup-pro.zip file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the Site Checkup menu in your WordPress dashboard.
